october_attack.locator: Israeli casualties; source and immediate-aftermath footnotes
october_attack.verification_basis: Downloaded document and relevant passage checked against the question; indexed primary text also checked where available.

siege.verification_basis: Announcement cross-checked in January-order record and the full Commission report, including the dated quotation.

aims.verification_basis: Dated statement and URL checked against existing bank; official source corroborated by contemporaneous reporting. URL year is misleading, as noted.
aims.limitations: Source URL contains 2023 but the statement is dated 6 January 2024; declared aims do not settle actual intent.

ministry.verification_basis: Full canonical Associated Press article read through web retrieval.
ministry.limitations: Institutional affiliation does not authenticate or discredit every individual record.

croatia.limitations: Finding concerns the evidence and parties in that case, not Gaza.

targeting.verification_basis: ICRC primary page read through web retrieval.
targeting.limitations: Not a factual finding about any particular Gaza attack.

hostages.verification_basis: Downloaded document and relevant passage checked against the question; indexed primary text also checked where available.

expulsion.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.

warning.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
warning.limitations: Interim decision, not a finding of genocidal intent; famine observation differs from a later technical classification.

shifa.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
shifa.limitations: Underlying intelligence not fully public; neither a neutral court finding nor validation of every Israeli claim about hospitals.

displacement_scale.verification_basis: Downloaded document and relevant passage checked against the question; indexed primary text also checked where available.

jelisic.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
jelisic.limitations: The appeal concerns an individual; do not turn every military objective into a personal motive or treat mixed intent as proved.

water.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
water.limitations: Human Rights Watch investigation; legal conclusions attributed, not treated as court findings.

ceasefire.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
ceasefire.limitations: Observed improvement does not establish adequacy everywhere or explain every decision.

survey.verification_basis: Publisher and PubMed indexed abstracts agree on 2,000 households, 75,200 and interval; correction notice recorded. DOI fetch itself returned a redirect stub.
survey.limitations: Accessible-area household sampling with displaced populations representing inaccessible governorates; raking uses official demographic frames. Separate from ministry death enumeration, not independent of every official input. Recall and missing or entirely lost households remain limitations.

coi.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
coi.limitations: Commission applies reasonable grounds; no court verdict. Access constraints, overlapping underlying reports and contested inferences remain material.

state.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
state.limitations: Attribution of conduct does not itself establish genocidal intent.

health.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
health.limitations: Operational and damage assessment; not an attack-by-attack attribution or legality audit.

tunnel.verification_basis: Full canonical Associated Press article and captions read through web retrieval.
tunnel.limitations: Access was military-controlled; observing a tunnel does not prove every claimed connection or justify the entire surrounding destruction.

shields.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.

evacuation.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
evacuation.limitations: Selected investigated cases; not an audit of every evacuation order.

srebrenica.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.

power.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
power.limitations: The line supplied a desalination plant; do not call it the only source of all drinking water in Gaza.

may_access.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
may_access.limitations: Counts refer to different stages, not three independent measures of household consumption.

projection.verification_basis: Original correspondence and PubMed record checked; DOI fetch itself returned a redirect stub.

kitchen.verification_basis: Full IDF primary release read through web retrieval; raw HTTP response was an anti-bot shell.
kitchen.limitations: Military account of intent and discipline is not independent criminal adjudication.

ground_combat2025.locator: Israeli security official’s account of explosive devices during the Beit Hanoun operation
ground_combat2025.verification_basis: Associated Press report checked through its indexed text describing explosives during the Beit Hanoun operation. The IDF public briefing of 8 July corroborates the five deaths in northern Gaza; it does not independently verify every detail of the mechanism.
ground_combat2025.limitations: Direct Associated Press access returned 403; this is an attributed account, not independent verification of the attack.

famine.verification_basis: IPC primary August snapshot and indexed assessment checked; direct snapshot fetch blocked.
famine.limitations: Technical classification, disputed by Israel; classification is not a genocide judgment.

december.verification_basis: IPC primary page read through web retrieval.
december.limitations: Improvement after ceasefire does not retrospectively disprove earlier famine; ongoing needs and access conditions remain.

damage_end2025.verification_basis: Downloaded document and relevant passage checked against the question; indexed primary text also checked where available.

kosovo.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.

reproduction.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
reproduction.limitations: Reported destruction and consequences do not themselves establish deliberate embryo targeting.

resettlement.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
resettlement.limitations: US account of represented policy and ministerial statements; not proof of implementation.

group.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.

medics.verification_basis: Publisher-verified footage report plus the official military investigation and Commission paragraph 185.
medics.limitations: Shows the signals and vehicles; does not itself settle all surrounding circumstances or wider intent.

looting.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
looting.limitations: Other updates report 98 trucks; do not quiz the disputed last digit or assume a specific armed group was responsible.

detention.locator: Paragraphs 38–41: military detention, shackling, abuse and Gaza-specific scope
detention.verification_basis: Primary report downloaded and paragraphs 38–41 checked. Paragraph 38 identifies Gaza detainees and harsh shackling; paragraph 41 includes both Gaza and West Bank detainees in alleged sexual violence.
detention.limitations: Accounts and findings are attributed to OHCHR; prevalence and genocidal intent are not independently established.

interim.verification_basis: ICJ summary of the same January order downloaded; historical order also checked in official indexed text.

synthesis.locator: Paragraphs 47–49; read with Convention Article II and ICJ Croatia v. Serbia inference standard
synthesis.verification_basis: Convention Article II, Jelisić paragraphs 47–49, and the Croatia v. Serbia inference standard read together; no conclusion on Gaza is made the answer key.

amnesty.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
amnesty.limitations: Not a court verdict; its treatment of disregard as evidence of intent must not be presented as a binding legal rule.

warrants.verification_basis: ICC primary press-release text checked through indexed retrieval, including the dated reasonable-grounds wording.
warrants.limitations: Arrest warrants are not convictions or genocide findings; question is historical and does not assert their current procedural status.

rwanda_context.verification_basis: Downloaded document and relevant passage checked against the question; indexed primary text also checked where available.

rockets.verification_basis: Associated Press syndicated report checked through indexed text; May 2024 United Nations monthly bulletin independently records the 26 May barrage. Direct syndicated-page access was restricted.
rockets.limitations: Establishes a continuing armed capability, not military necessity for every Israeli action or absence of additional intent.

march_policy.verification_basis: Primary announcement is quoted and linked in official hearing records and Commission paragraphs 116–119; operational corroboration in March mechanism record.
march_policy.limitations: Official rationale is evidence of a stated purpose, not proof that it was the sole purpose.

croatia_result.verification_basis: Primary document downloaded; relevant passage located and compared with the tested factual proposition.
